top_stories.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
top_stories.summary: A new attack technique called "workflow identity hijacking" has been identified, which can bypass standard security controls by exploiting unauthenticated entry points to compromise enterprise data. The attack targets identity-based weaknesses in AI workflows, allowing threat actors to hijack organizational data without requiring authenticated access.

top_stories.title: Passkey-themed phishing attacks lead to Microsoft 365 data theft
top_stories.summary: Threat actors linked to ShinyHunters, Helix, and other extortion gangs are conducting passkey and SSO-themed social engineering attacks to compromise corporate Microsoft 365 accounts. The attacks exploit user familiarity with passkey and single sign-on authentication flows to trick victims into surrendering credentials or access.

top_stories.title: Attackers Use Passkey Phishing to Hijack Microsoft Cloud Accounts and Exfiltrate Data
top_stories.summary: Microsoft disclosed two threat campaigns, including one using passkey-themed social engineering to breach cloud environments and exfiltrate data. The attacks involved abusing third-party email delivery infrastructure and CEO impersonation to send over one million scam emails between August 3-5, 2026.

top_stories.title: JumpCloud extends Agentic IAM with new controls for autonomous AI agents
top_stories.summary: JumpCloud has extended its Agentic IAM service with new controls that give IT teams direct management over autonomous AI agents within their organizations. The update brings AI agents under the same identity and access management framework as human users and traditional workloads.

top_stories.title: Florida confirms DMV database breached via stolen police account
top_stories.summary: The Florida DHSMV confirmed its DAVID driver database was breached by attackers using stolen credentials from a police department employee account. The incident highlights privileged account compromise as the attack vector, with law enforcement credentials providing unauthorized access to sensitive DMV records.

news.title: What we know about the Revolut data breach so far
news.summary: Revolut suffered a data breach in which an attacker impersonated a government agency using a spoofed official email domain to obtain sensitive customer records including birthdates, addresses, phone numbers, and identity documents such as passports and driving licences. The incident highlights vulnerabilities in identity verification and social engineering-based authorization bypass, with Revolut confirming a limited number of customers were affected and notifying them directly.

news.title: Permify: Open-source authorization as a service
news.summary: Permify is an open-source authorization service that centralizes access control rules separately from application code, answering real-time permission queries such as user-to-resource access decisions. The system follows the Google Zanzibar design pattern, which underpins fine-grained, nested authorization across complex permission structures.

news.title: Malicious Twitch Browser Extension Leaks OAuth Tokens From Nearly 31,000 Users
news.summary: A malicious browser extension called "Twitch Enhanced Viewer | JeetBot" exfiltrated OAuth tokens from nearly 31,000 Twitch users to Russian-operated proxy servers. The attack demonstrates a cross-store supply chain threat vector where stolen OAuth tokens enable unauthorized access without requiring user credentials.

news.title: Bastillion v5.2.1
news.summary: Bastillion released version 5.2.1 of its browser-based SSH access management tool, which functions as a bastion host with a management dashboard. The tool provides centralized SSH access control across systems via a web interface.

news.title: Okta Nearly Doubled This Year. So Why Is SailPoint Still Below Its IPO Price?
news.summary: The article compares stock performance between Okta and SailPoint, noting SailPoint reported Q2 FY27 results with its fourth consecutive EPS beat while remaining below its IPO price. The piece is primarily a financial/investment analysis of two IAM vendors rather than coverage of product, security, or industry developments.

news.title: Okta Targets AI Agent Confusion With Identity Security Push
news.summary: Okta is positioning its identity security platform as a solution for managing AI agent access, focusing on controlling where agents operate, which systems they can access, and what actions they are authorized to perform. The push reflects growing industry attention to non-human identity management as AI agents proliferate across enterprise environments.

news.title: Artifactory flaws chained in attacks deploying backdoor malware
news.summary: Threat actors are chaining critical and high-severity vulnerabilities in JFrog Artifactory to bypass authentication and gain administrative privileges on self-hosted servers. The attack chain results in deployment of a Rust-based backdoor on compromised systems.

news.title: Agentic Fabric and AI Could Drive SailPoint’s (SAIL) Next Growth Phase
news.summary: SailPoint reported its fiscal Q2 2027 results on September 9, showing 25% annual recurring revenue growth year-over-year. The company is positioning its Agentic Fabric and AI capabilities as key drivers for its next growth phase in enterprise identity security.

news.title: Univention Corporate Server: Who Does the Cloud Trust When You Log In?
news.summary: Approximately 5,000 Dropbox accounts were compromised through improperly verified Lenovo IDs, highlighting federated identity trust issues in cloud environments. The incident centers on authentication and identity verification failures in cross-platform login scenarios, a core concern for IAM professionals managing federated access.

news.title: AI is changing what Salesforce security needs to govern
news.summary: WithSecure published a paper titled "Navigating Trust in the Modern Salesforce Ecosystem" examining how AI is expanding Salesforce security and governance requirements. The paper argues that traditional governance frameworks focused on identities, permissions, access, and configurations must evolve to address new AI-introduced risks in Salesforce environments.

news.title: authentik version/2026.8.2
news.summary: authentik released version 2026.8.2 of its open-source identity provider platform. The release supports SSO functionality across SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, and RADIUS protocols for centralized authentication and access management.

news.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
news.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act begins enforcing a 24-hour mandatory reporting requirement for serious product security incidents affecting European organizations. This regulation introduces new compliance obligations relevant to IAM vendors and enterprise security teams operating in the EU.

news.title: CISA Flags Exploited Cisco, Citrix, Fortinet Flaws, Sets Sept. 12 Federal Patch Deadline
news.summary: CISA added three critical vulnerabilities affecting Cisco, Citrix, and Fortinet to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, with a September 12, 2026 patch deadline for federal agencies. One of the flaws, CVE-2026-20079, carries a CVSS score of 10.0 and involves an authentication vulnerability.

news.title: There's a New Black Market Just for Stolen ChatGPT and Claude Logins. It's Open 24/7.
news.summary: Okta has published a report revealing the emergence of black markets on Telegram trading stolen AI service account credentials, including logins for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor. These markets operate continuously with features like customer support, money-back guarantees, and bulk pricing for stolen tokens.

news.title: TATS
news.summary: A tool called TATS has been released for analyzing and tracking OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and Microsoft Entra ID tokens captured from Burp Suite, mitmproxy, or Chrome DevTools. It provides features including token lifecycle visualization, risky scope detection, and token export for replay testing via an interactive dashboard.

news.title: Infostealer Logs Expose Replayable AI Tokens That Can Bypass MFA
news.summary: Cybercriminals are using infostealer malware logs to extract replayable AI session tokens and API keys that can bypass MFA protections on AI platform accounts. Tools like Lumma Stealer and Vidar are harvesting credentials, session tokens, and API keys from compromised systems, enabling account takeover of services from providers like Google and Anthropic.

news.title: SailPoint, Inc. Q2 2027 Earnings Call Summary
news.summary: SailPoint held its Q2 2027 earnings call, with a summary published covering the company's financial results. The call pertains to the IAM/IGA vendor SailPoint, though the summary description provides no specific financial figures, product updates, or strategic announcements.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch update addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. Microsoft attributed the increased vulnerability discovery rate to AI assistance, while security experts noted organizations are struggling to prioritize and deploy the high volume of monthly fixes.

news.title: Old, Unpatched Flaws Give Attackers Access to Philippines Nuclear Agency
news.summary: Threat actors exploited unpatched vulnerabilities in ownCloud to breach the Philippines Nuclear Agency, stealing credential stores among other sensitive data. The attack leveraged commodity vulnerabilities to gain initial access, resulting in the exfiltration of reactor databases and personnel records.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has launched an official inquiry into the breach.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian national Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in stolen data including over 100 million AT&T customer records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem after a contractor exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection and response processes relevant to IAM and PAM practices.
